resources.string:
Health data in My Fitness Diary

What MFD reads
With your permission (you can allow each one separately), MFD reads from Health Connect: sleep, steps, heart rate, resting heart rate, heart-rate variability, weight and body fat. It reads nothing else.

How it is used
• Recovery check-ins (Progress → Recovery): hours slept, steps, resting heart rate and heart-rate variability for the last 7 days. Sleep is only filled in on days you haven't entered it yourself.
• Your workouts: heart rate during each workout (average, maximum, zones and a graph).
• Weigh-ins: weight and body fat measured by your scale or watch, on days you haven't entered them yourself.
MFD reads this only while the app is open.

What MFD saves to Health Connect
Only if you turn it on (Settings → Health & devices, separately for each): your finished workouts (name, start and end time, and the heart rate your watch recorded in MFD), and the food you log (name, meal, calories, protein, carbs, fat, sugars, saturated fat, fibre and sodium). Samsung Health and other apps you allow can then show them. Changes and deletions in MFD are passed on. Turning it off stops saving; what was saved stays in Health Connect until you delete it there.

Where it goes
These values are saved in your own diary, in your MFD account, like everything else you log. They are not shared with friends, not sent to ChatGPT, Claude or any other service, not used for ads, and never sold.

Your control
You can stop at any time: Health Connect → App permissions → My Fitness Diary. Check-ins already filled in stay in your diary until you delete them (Progress → Recovery → ⋮ → Delete check-in).
